observed_discontinuity: Frozen Bubble GameThread.<init> calls BitmapFactory.decodeResource(Resources, int, Options). AGR skipped the unresolved method, so the source Bitmap stayed null and scaleFrom threw NullPointerException.
required_semantics: decodeResource(Resources, int, Options) returns a Bitmap whose width and height are the decoded pixel dimensions.
A missing or undecodable resource returns null.
Options.inBitmap set and a failed decode throws IllegalArgumentException.
Options.inJustDecodeBounds returns null and writes outWidth and outHeight without allocating pixel backing.
Bitmap.getWidth and Bitmap.getHeight return those dimensions.

differences.description: API19 BitmapFactory.decodeResource opens the raw resource and returns a Bitmap with pixels. AGR previously had no LLIL method, so the invoke was skipped and the result was null. AGR now decodes through agr_bitmap and retains host pixels keyed by guest Bitmap identity.
differences.relevance: GameThread stores real source bitmaps. Canvas.drawBitmap consumes those pixels.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: API19 decodeResource(Resources, int, Options) returns the decoded Bitmap; AGR skipped Landroid/graphics/BitmapFactory;.decodeResource LLIL.

evidence.artifact: Pinned android-4.4.4_r2 BitmapFactory.decodeResource and Bitmap.getWidth/getHeight/recycle in framework.graphics.bitmap_decode_resource

Local host probe of unchanged org.jfedor.frozenbubble 1.7: decodeResource returns Bitmaps with host agr_bitmap backing for PNG, JPEG, and GIF. First drawBitmap source is res/drawable/background.jpg JPEG 640x480. inJustDecodeBounds still returns null without pixel decode.
Linux agr-bitmap-draw-host PASS for fixture-2x2.png RGBA layout, Frozen Bubble background.jpg, and bubble GIF Index8 expand.

remaining_uncertainty: Density scaling is not applied. Frozen Bubble sets Options.inScaled false through unresolved reflection, and the returned size is the decoded pixel size.
next_action: Do not strip pixel backing. Protect decode failure and inJustDecodeBounds contracts. drawBitmap ownership remains framework-canvas-bitmap.json.
host_adaptation: Guest Bitmap identity maps to a host agr_bitmap without storing a host pointer in a guest field. KitKat SkImageDecoder through agr_bitmap stands in for BitmapFactory native decode. Pixel layout is little-endian RGBA. Nine-patch PNG content size subtracts the one-pixel border when an npTc chunk is present.
